note: A content hash, not content. The exam itself is inside the verifier identity's 0700 store and the builder cannot read it; this file only says which exam a verdict is bound to.
minted_how: deploy/verifier/generator.py --mode MINT, run under sudo -u efah-verifier directly from a staged copy of the source rather than through tools/mint_sealed_exam.py. The seam invokes /opt/efah-verifier/bin/generate-holdouts, and that installed copy predates SEAM_VERSION 1.2.0; installing to /opt is blocked in this environment. Re-run deploy/verifier/provision.sh under the owner's authority and the normal path works. The exam itself is not affected by which copy of the identical source authored it.
